notes.title: 07.11.22 - What have we been up to?
notes.content:
Hey hey!

Seeing how we haven't given any sign of life for the last year, allow us to quickly tell you where we stand with our project...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41377122/04cf486a6ba0e8c9353ef67e821fb7203e40d721.png

That's right! A new title!

"ClockWork" evolved into "ClockVenture". Let's welcome it with thunderous ovations!


And now for something completely different:

 Playable demo! In a month, we are planning to show you our game in action.
 Following the release of a demo, we will want to take care of better communication. That means Discord channel. You'll be able to join soon.
 As for the release date... we'd prefer to wait with this one :]


That's it for today! See you soon!
